title: Show stable timestamps on changed viewer sections
changes: Record actual UTC added or updated times by scope and section in a maintained registry, preserving them across wiki regeneration.
Show local date and time badges on affected section disclosures, sidebar links and parent navbar or category menus, retaining the exact UTC value in the time element.
Support both split and single-page viewers and document the required registry update for future section changes.
validation: Synthetic viewer-e360-compact-synthetic-md0max7y passed 24 tests including timestamp stability, topic and index badges, a narrow mobile viewport and existing navigation.
Protected viewer-e360-compact-real-nxxwgbvm verified two dated sections in Chrome and matched 605 Python/Docker outputs; published with preimages out/ffta-e360-compact-before-cv22fk1j.
limitations: Section change timestamps must be recorded when sections are added or modified; browser display uses the local time zone. Native Windows is unverified.
